selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-change sysctl values, boot_id bccb87ac-2704-41fb-ab29-fb36e0053c13, systemctl is-system-running=running, and interface state before rebooting.
Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf disabling accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route for all/default.

selected_evidence.requirement: Configuration applied and effective at runtime
selected_evidence.summary: Applied via sysctl --system, verified per-interface state, corrected stale enp1s0 value so all live interfaces show accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0.
systemctl reboot issued on node1; command returned before the connection dropped, confirming the restart was triggered.

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Polled node1 until reachable; boot_id changed from bccb87ac-2704-41fb-ab29-fb36e0053c13 to 242efcb7-4043-48e9-bc22-e109c236060c, proving a real reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of hardening settings
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot sysctl values for all/default/enp1s0 remained 0 (persisted via sysctl.d), system reported running/healthy with network connectivity restored; lo interface's accept_redirects re-applied to 0 for completeness.
